actionPrompts:
Production football animation sprite sheet for Sunday Arcade. Match the supplied neutral-character reference EXACTLY in cartoon 3D sports-game style, head proportions, face identities, hair, uniforms and jersey numbers. This is a LANDSCAPE TRANSPARENT atlas of EXACTLY SIX COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS (24 individual complete full-body figures). Each row represents one team's quarterback in columns 1-3 and its kicker in columns 4-6. Use regular equal cells, generous 8% transparent margins, feet fully inside every cell. Heads and torsos same scale and fixed center in every cell. No helmets. No footballs: the engine draws the ball separately.
Column 1: quarterback WINDUP, plant left foot, turn hips sideways slightly right, right upper arm raised, elbow bent 90 degrees, throwing hand behind and above right shoulder, left hand forward balancing.
Column 2: same quarterback RELEASE, stride onto planted left leg, hips and shoulders rotate right, right elbow extends, throwing hand high forward to right, realistic overhand pass with hand above head.
Column 3: same quarterback FOLLOW THROUGH, weight on left front leg, torso rotated right, right arm continues down across body, rear right foot lifts slightly.
Column 4: kicker BACKSWING, left plant foot next to imaginary ball to right, right thigh draws backward left, right knee bends and right cleat swings behind, arms naturally balance.
Column 5: same kicker CONTACT, left foot planted firmly, right leg swings toward right, right knee almost straight and right foot points forward at shin height, instep facing ball, hips rotating, eyes down at imaginary ball.
Column 6: same kicker FOLLOW THROUGH, left foot stays planted, kicking right leg extends high toward right, torso leans back slightly, arms spread naturally. Full anatomy, two arms, two legs, correct connected joints in ALL frames.
Rows:
Row 1: eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts #1 (columns 1,2,3); eagles kicker Jake Elliott #4 (columns 4,5,6).
Row 2: cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott #4 (columns 1,2,3); cowboys kicker Brandon Aubrey #17 (columns 4,5,6).
Row 3: giants quarterback Jaxson Dart #6 (columns 1,2,3); giants kicker Graham Gano #9 (columns 4,5,6).
Row 4: commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels #5 (columns 1,2,3); commanders kicker Drew Stevens #19 (columns 4,5,6).
